Job Description 
 At General Motors, our product teams are redefining mobility. Through a human-centered design process, we create vehicles and experiences that are designed not just to be seen, but to be felt. We’re turning today’s impossible into tomorrow’s standard —from breakthrough hardware and battery systems to intuitive design, intelligent software, and next-generation safety and entertainment features.   
 Every day, our products move millions of people as we aim to make driving safer, smarter, and more connected, shaping the future of transportation on a global scale. 
  The Role: 
 This role advances the cutting edge of AI Research applied to structures and materials, particularly towards General Motors Defense needs. In addition, the role provides Technical thought leadership and shaping for the GM Fellows and Technical Leaders Program.  You will lead a critical portfolio of advanced research, define strategy for contract research and secure, and set the technical vision for the GM Fellows Program. 
 Your immediate focus will be to lead innovation across several core technical domains, including:
 In this role, you will help define, develop, and mature research and scientific applications of computational design from molecular level to full scale with the infusion of AI and world model advancements. You will guide advanced technologies from early research through system-relevant demonstrations. You will provide chief scientist level advising to engineers and executive leadership across GM. You will also build a strong external partnership network across suppliers, universities, startups, government, and advanced technology organizations to leverage investments and amplify GM’s internal efforts.  
 What You Do (Responsibilities): 
 ·       Scientifically guide Defense technology and chart related research strategy through active collaboration with stakeholders. 
 ·       Provide technology leadership in AI vehicle systems research and develop strategic roadmaps in collaboration with key stakeholders. 
 ·       Provide Chief Scientist level guidance for R&D portfolio that provides actionable improvements. 
 ·       Optimize internal and external capability to execute the project portfolio, including leveraged funding and collaborations with academia, government labs, suppliers, startups, and other external partners. 
 ·       Drive innovation and documentation of research developments through mentoring others to produce records of invention, internal reports, and external publications. 
 ·       Strengthen GM global network with key universities, government labs, industrial labs, and strategic partners to access world-class technology. 
 ·       Technically lead cross-functional discussions, leadership reviews, and communication of results and progress across the organization. 
 ·       Manage activities of researchers, including setting objectives, managing results, evaluating individual performance, coaching, and mentoring, and career planning for positive engagement. 
 ·       Consistently demonstrate critical thinking and strong collaboration. 
 ·       Be a champion for safety in the workplace. 
  
 Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications): 
 ·       PhD degree in Scientific field 
 ·       10+ years relevant work experience in scientific roles. 
 ·       Demonstrated national recognition 
 ·       Track record of research or technology implementation. 
 ·       Innovation track record as documented by patents and high scholars index. 
 ·       Strong, charismatic leader with excellent people skills. 
 ·       Experience leading research portfolio, including project planning, management, and budget responsibility. 
 ·       Recognized government contract research or program capture. 
 ·       Ability to guide multiple projects spanning different technical areas in parallel. 
 ·       Ability to communicate complex concepts and situations clearly and at the appropriate level for various audiences. 
 ·       Demonstrated ability to break through barriers to execute plans. 
 ·       Experience in applied AI/machine learning and digital tools. 
 ·       Deep technical grounding in Defense related systems and materials.  
 What Can Give You a Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications): 
 ·       Experience leading research teams from concept creation through hardware or system demonstration. 
 ·       Defense industry or government lab experience. 
 ·       Demonstrated performance in roles requiring both high creativity and strong technical excellence. 
 ·       Strong evidence of career performance excellence in positions of increasing responsibility, challenge, and leadership. 
 ·       Experience building effective external collaborations with universities, suppliers, startups, and government-sponsored programs. 
 ·  Experience in energy materials. 




 About GM 
 Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.
 
 Why Join Us  
 We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.
 
 Benefits Overview 
 From day one, we're looking out for your well-being–at work and at home–so you can focus on realizing your ambitions. Learn how GM supports a rewarding career that rewards you personally by visiting Total Rewards resources .
 
 Non-Discrimination and Equal Employment Opportunities (U.S.) 
 General Motors is committed to being a workplace that is not only free of unlawful discrimination, but one that genuinely fosters inclusion and belonging. We strongly believe that providing an inclusive workplace creates an environment in which our employees can thrive and develop better products for our customers.
 
 All employment decisions are made on a non-discriminatory basis without regard to sex, race, color, national origin, citizenship status, religion, age, disability, pregnancy or maternity status, sexual orientation, gender identity, status as a veteran or protected veteran, or any other similarly protected status in accordance with federal, state and local laws. 
 
 We encourage interested candidates to review the key responsibilities and qualifications for each role and apply for any positions that match their skills and capabilities. Applicants in the recruitment process may be required, where applicable, to successfully complete a role-related assessment(s) and/or a pre-employment screening prior to beginning employment. To learn more, visit How we Hire .
 
 Accommodations 
 General Motors offers opportunities to all job seekers including individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to assist with your job search or application for employment, email us or call us at 1-800-865-7580. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.
